development_questions: Does the benchmark-v1 uncertainty heuristic underperform simpler baselines across multiple non-locked development replays?
How wide is the random-acquisition performance distribution across deterministic random seeds?
Is strategy ranking stable across model families, or is acquisition quality strongly learner-dependent?

scientific_boundary: The benchmark-v1 locked-test file and targets must not be read by this replay.
Development replay results may diagnose and motivate policy-v2 design but are not independent policy evidence.
No policy-v2 rule is promoted or frozen by this replay alone.
Any future policy-v2 implementation must be frozen before evaluation on a new independent benchmark.
Negative development results must be preserved and must not trigger hidden benchmark-v1 retuning.
